_design_note:
Rainbow on the handcrafted line, all six components this time: Double DQN, n-step(5), prioritized replay, a C51 distributional head, the dueling split, and noisy networks in place of epsilon-greedy. Route R02_11 carries the three that are agent design (categorical, dueling, noisy); the experiment carries the three that are not (double_dqn, n_step, replay.sampling).

Two implementation choices worth stating, because neither is forced.

The noise is a training mechanism and evaluation uses the mean weights alone. Every other exploration mechanism on this line is switched off for evaluation -- epsilon is set to 0 -- the reported numbers are greedy by that definition, and a stochastic evaluation would also cost the bit-exact reproducibility the solo suite depends on (section 7.14.1). This is a deliberate deviation from the paper, which keeps the noise at evaluation time.

The budget is 10000 rounds rather than 5000, and that is the one part with evidence behind it: the prioritized arm's learning curve was below R02_9 at every checkpoint and still climbing at 5000 (15.14 / 15.52 / 16.42 at rounds 3000 / 4000 / 5000 against R02_9's 16.49 / 16.38 / 16.60). A 5000-round Rainbow arm would measure an unfinished agent.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: Six against R02_9. A submission candidate, not an ablation; the credit is not divisible and this arm does not claim otherwise. The single-factor arms are runs/rep_c51 (categorical), runs/rep_per (prioritized), runs/rep_budget (10000 rounds); dueling and noisy have none, so a win cannot be attributed to them either.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/rep_lr/ (R02_9, ten repeats, score 3.6371). The component arms are runs/rep_c51 (C51 alone), runs/rep_per (PER alone), runs/rep_budget (10000 rounds with the scalar head, t = -0.27).
_predeclared_design_numbers.cost: Measured: C51 is 482 us per gradient step against the scalar head's 259, and a 10000-round arm takes about 1.2 million of them. Training about 3.5 hours, evaluation about 35 minutes at checkpoint_every 500, repeats about 10 minutes.
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: Indistinguishable from R02_9 over ten repeats closes the Rainbow direction on the handcrafted line, and with it every algorithmic lever this codebase has.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: Low, and for a reason the data already gives. Every stack tried on this line has failed to compose: C51 at 7000 rounds lost both parents' best numbers, and the budget's effect on coins reverses sign under the distributional head (section 7.36). The reason to run it anyway is that Rainbow is the configuration these components were tuned together as, and that prioritized replay has never been given the rounds its own curve asks for.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training-seed distributions, coins_share and suicides beside every score, the learning curve, and the per-seed holdout numbers -- the submission is one model, not the pooled mean (section 7.37).
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Ten repeats per arm of the same fifteen holdout jobs, Welch, |t| > 2.3 (section 7.20.6).
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_ceiling_this_cannot_pass: Section 7.34: 4.9 of the 8.2 coins a round appear more than six cells away when they are revealed, where the win rate is under 25%. No algorithmic component moves that horizon; only a representation that sees further does.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_mechanism_check: Four, all recorded per gradient step, any of which voids the arm. mean_importance_weight below 1.0, or the prioritization never engaged. mean_target inside [-2, 12], or the atom grid is clipping. mean_noise_scale away from zero at the end, or the noisy layers collapsed and the arm trained greedily with no exploration at all. The loot-crate curve flat by 10000, or it is still undertrained.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_parameter_count: The head is now (6 + 1) x 51 = 357 wide against R02_9's 6, and every weight carries a sigma, so the model holds roughly 5x R02_9's parameters. No version of Rainbow avoids that, and section 7.24.1 found width interacts with step size here, so a win is 'Rainbow' and not 'these six ideas'.
